caption: The drawing depicts a corner of a room with a metal wood-burning stove placed near the intersection of two walls. The stove is rectangular and black, supported by four legs that stand on a rectangular metal sheet. Attached to the front of the stove is a round, flat, horizontal surface with a handle, likely a door for accessing the combustion chamber. A long, vertical black pipe extends upward from the top of the stove and bends at a right angle as it approaches the wall, suggesting a vent or chimney function. Behind the stove, to the left, is a tall, narrow, wooden cabinet with two paneled doors and a drawer set into the lower portion. The walls are colored light gray, and the floor consists of reddish-brown wooden planks. The baseboards and the trim of the cabinet are painted in a lighter brown, matching the floor. The overall style of the drawing is clean and precise, with clear lines and muted colors.
title: Shaker Stove
